content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal replaces the oversized rewrite with a single concise `insert_after` at § 15.12: a mutual cap at the greater of "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim" and USD 1,000,000, the preferred carve-outs, and the express statement that Customer's payment obligations are not damages — leaving § 15.11's existing damages exclusions and the PB Article 6 / Section 14.2 avoidance-of-doubt sentence byte-for-byte untouched. All official checks and the minimality gate now pass.
